rationale: The assistant correctly identified the run-on as the normal cooling fan matching the hidden truth, grounded its conclusion in the customer's confirmed evidence (oven still warm, door shut, Beko) and gave proportionate fault thresholds (hours with a cold oven, odd noises) with isolation and manufacturer/technician referral only in that case. Calibration moved sensibly from 'probably not broken' to 'completely normal' once warmth was confirmed. The only minor gap is that it never explicitly asked whether the fan has always stopped by itself on previous occasions, though its 'still running after a couple of hours' guidance covers that unknown adequately. No parts, no fabrication, no repetition.
